markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if official first-round results determining whether any candidate met the threshold are announced.
markets.rules_primary: If any candidate receives the required threshold of votes to be declared the winner after the first round of voting in the next French presidential election, eliminating the need for any subsequent rounds, runoffs, or instant-runoff tabulations, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The market resolves to Yes if any candidate receives more than 50% of the votes cast (suffrages exprimés) in the first round of voting, so that no second round is required. Blank and null ballots are not counted. A second round, if held, has no bearing on this market. The market resolves once the Conseil constitutionnel proclaims the first-round results.
markets.title: Will anyone win the next French presidential election in the first round?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if a person is formally appointed and invested as Prime Minister.
markets.rules_primary: If Antti Lindtman becomes Prime Minister of Finland as a result of government formation following the 2027 Finnish parliamentary election and meets all constitutional requirements before Apr 18, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The market resolves to the first person who, as a result of government formation following the election, is formally appointed, sworn in, or invested as Prime Minister according to the country's constitutional procedures, commands the confidence of the parliament/legislature, and exercises the full powers of the office (not serving in a caretaker/acting capacity from the previous government).

If no government forms by Apr 18, 2028, the Contract resolves to "No one" if that is an option and No for all other strikes. If new elections are called before government formation, the Contract resolves to "No one" immediately and No for all other strikes.

markets.rules_secondary:
This event resolves to the first office Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez officially announces she is running for in 2028, after Issuance and before Apr 15, 2028. An official announcement is a public statement by Ocasio-Cortez or her campaign that she is running for that office, including for a party's nomination for it.

If a single announcement names more than one office, the highest of President, Senate, House and Another office, in that order, resolves to Yes. A later switch or withdrawal does not change the result.

Another office means any other elected office on a 2028 ballot, including Vice President. Being named a running mate counts as announcing a run for Vice President.

The following do NOT count:
Filing paperwork without an announcement, such as an FEC statement of candidacy or ballot petitions
An exploratory committee, or saying she is interested in or considering a run
Running for a leadership post in Congress, such as Speaker or caucus leader

If she makes no official announcement before Apr 15, 2028, None resolves to Yes.

Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Announcements with a specified future implementation date

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents or unofficial reports not confirmed by government sources
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval or adoption
Regional or sub-national actions
Retraction of previously announced commitments
